patch_description: This block reduces the circuit from two trainable angles per repetition to one, lowering the total parameter count from 14 to 8 including readout calibration. The shared angle drives both collective RY mixing and collective RZ phase evolution, preserving noncommuting repeated dynamics despite the reduction. Fixed nearest- and next-nearest-neighbor CZ layers broaden correlation propagation without adding parameters, targeting the same perfect accuracy with higher parameter efficiency and potentially lower loss.
